name: instrument_store_incremental_reload_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: INSTRUMENT_STORE_INCREMENTAL_RELOAD_20261109 — one InstrumentRecordStore per resolved path, and a
read catches up from the append tail instead of re-parsing the whole canonical store.
Measured defect (2026-11-09): /api/v2/overview spent 7.36 of its 8.49 s in cio_company_facts.load_snapshot ->
InstrumentRecordStore.all(), re-parsing 805,710,421 bytes / 86,558 lines into a 5,680-subject projection
(6.76 s warm, 18.3 s cold), because _store_for_root built a new store per call and _load returned a stale
_cache once populated. The store is append-hot (+139,046 bytes in 6 m 15 s), so every append forced a full
parse and its ~191 MB transient ratcheted the heap. This gate fails if _store_for_root stops returning one
object per resolved path, if a reused store stops seeing rows appended after its first read, if an append
costs a full parse, if truncation / replacement / an in-place same-length rewrite / a half-written final
line stop being re-read, if the rows handed out stop being copies, or if the stale-write guard stops firing.
Hermetic: tmp dirs only, no DB, no network.
